answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted liveness: each agent must post a bond and emit a signed pulse every epoch. The verifier tracks the delta between expected and observed pulses; agents drifting beyond tolerance lose bond weight. Over a rolling horizon of 28 epochs, identities with erratic pulse history are throttled, so farming thousands of fake agents costs real capital per identity and earns nothing until the horizon clears.
